description: Minimal capability for the click-through snap-guides overlay window. Grants only what `routes/snap-guides/+page.svelte` needs: invoke for `get_snap_guide_state` (custom command, allowed by `core:default`) and listen for `snap-guides:state` (app-defined event, requires `core:event:allow-listen` explicitly — `core:default` does NOT include event listening for app events in Tauri 2). No filesystem, shell, notifications, or any other permissions — the overlay is content-only and should never touch the host system directly.
